description: Cards with a quantity field and an add button, under a live cart count.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Dishes added to the cart from the card: the live cart count over a grid of cards, each with a picture, name,
  weight, price and a quantity field named after the dish beside the add button. Axes: media (image, none),
  tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";

export type DishCartGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  dishes: Dish[];
  empty?: string;
  labels: FoodLabels;
  count?: number;
  media?: "image" | "none";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import AddQty from "../components/add-qty.vue";
import CartCount from "../components/cart-count.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  dishes,
  empty = "",
  labels,
  count = 0,
  media = "image",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<DishCartGridProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="shopping-bag" :title="empty" />
    <Stack v-else gap="4" align="stretch">
      <Group justify="end">
        <CartCount :count="count" :label="labels.inCart" />
      </Group>
      <Grid cols="1-3" class="gap-4" data-slot="items">
        <Stack
          v-for="d in dishes"
          :key="d.id"
          gap="4"
          class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border overflow-hidden pb-4"
          data-slot="item"
        >
          <MediaFrame v-if="((media as string) === 'image')" :alt="d.name" />
          <Stack gap="2" :class="(((media as string) === 'image') ? 'px-4' : 'px-4 pt-4')">
            <Group gap="2" align="baseline" justify="between">
              <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
                {{ d.name }}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {{ d.weight }}
              </Text>
            </Group>
            <Text size="lg" weight="bold">
              {{ fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency) }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Box class="px-4">
            <AddQty :name="tpl('{0}-qty-{1}', id, d.id)" :dish="d.name" :labels="labels" />
          </Box>
        </Stack>
      </Grid>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
